title: Man gets into argument with AI recruiter during interview, internet says 'same here'
body: A man shared how he got into an argument with an AI recruiter during a job interview, sparking debate over impersonal hiring processes and the growing role of automation in recruitment.

title: Who is Srinivas Narayanan? IIT Madras graduate behind ChatGPT growth exits OpenAI
body: OpenAI executive Srinivas Narayanan, an IIT Madras alumnus who helped scale ChatGPT and API products, has announced his exit after three years. He said he plans to spend time with his ageing parents in India before deciding his next career move.

title: Are AI chatbots giving you the wrong diagnosis? Study flags 50% error risk
body: LLMs were tested across 29 clinical scenarios, generating a total of 16,254 responses. The PrIME-LLM scores ranged from 0.64 for Gemini 1.5 Flash to 0.78 for Grok 4, indicating moderate overall performance. Models specifically optimised for reasoning performed better than standard ones, with GPT-based systems scoring among the highest.

title: Is Intel Stock a Buy Ahead of Earnings?
body: Following the tech stock's massive run-up this year, Intel commands a market capitalization of about $344 billion as of this writing. And the stock trades at an eye-watering 135 times forward earnings as of this writing.

title: Pope Leo says 'tyrants' comment wasn't directed at Trump
body: Pope Leo XIV said it is "not in my interest" to "debate" President Donald Trump. Leo has criticized conflict in Iran, sparking backlash from Trump.
